title: Kingdom of Benin
summary: The Edo kingdom of Benin grew out of the earlier kingdom of Igodomigodo and reached its height in the 15th and 16th centuries.
why: One of the oldest and most developed states of coastal West Africa.

unsung.contribution: Edo artists cast the Benin Bronzes from the 14th century onward.
unsung.recognition: Late-19th-century scholars wrongly said Benin's metalworking came from Portuguese traders.
